title: Waffuru installer releases
description: What https://waffuru.ai/<product>/releases.json returns: a product's installer, its latest published release and the pinned copies of recent releases.

product.description: The URL segment the installer is served under, for example iron.

repo.description: The GitHub repository the releases come from, as owner/name.

asset.description: The installer's file name, for example install.sh.

latest.description: The tag of the latest release.

path.description: The path of the latest installer, /<product>/<asset>.

releases.description: Recent releases, each with a pinned copy of the installer.

latest.description: True for the release the unversioned installer comes from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the release asset (the served script adds one header line; drop it before checking).

path.description: The path of this release's pinned installer, /<product>/<tag>/<asset>.
